target: Reservoir Protocol rUSD local PSM mint/redeem arbitrage on BSC
why: Official Reservoir address list places its PSM core on Ethereum and lists only bridged rUSD/wsrUSD tokens on BNB. Without a verified BSC PSM, the local atomic arbitrage leg cannot be built.

First call a known getter at the new address, then test fresh-address entry and quote a 400 USD or flash-funded same-transaction round trip. Do not use the unrelated same-name BSC token 0xa9015634...8e2a3. Evidence: attempts row from run 9a8b08bf; scratch/reservoir-addresses.md and scratch/reservoir-rusd-bsc-redeem*.json.
